ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: They need to wash: a water tub, basin, bathtub or shower with water in it, and the time to use it. Keep the tubs filled by hand or by rain, or plumb in a supply.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Keep the water coming and the baths free, and they'll stay clean.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: There was no toilet they could reach in time. Build enough latrines or toilets, close to where people sleep and work.
Someone saw them on the toilet or washing. Give toilets and baths rooms of their own, or put stall doors between them.
There was no hot water. A campfire or log boiler placed next to a bathtub heats it; once Heating is researched, a log boiler and hot water tanks heat the plumbing.
They had nothing clean to drink. Keep clean water within reach: a well away from sewage and latrines, and water tubs kept full.
Their bathroom is a grim place. It's rated like a bedroom: clean it, lay a floor and give it something nice to look at.
ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: Their bathroom impresses them. Keep it clean.
Clean water, a free bath and a toilet close by keep these small good moods coming.
